entries.text: Clearbrief lets creative teams share work with clients, collect comments, and track approvals in one place.
entries.quote: Clearbrief lets creative teams share work with clients, collect comments, and track approvals in one place.

entries.text: The Solo plan costs $19 per month and includes one team member and five active projects.
entries.quote: The Solo plan costs $19 per month and includes one team member and five active projects.

entries.text: The Team plan costs $49 per month and includes five team members and twenty active projects.
entries.quote: The Team plan costs $49 per month and includes five team members and twenty active projects.

entries.text: Both plans include unlimited client reviewers. Client reviewers can comment and approve work; they are not team members.
entries.quote: Both plans include unlimited client reviewers. Client reviewers can comment and approve work; they are not team members.

entries.text: Plans are billed monthly. Annual billing is not available.
entries.quote: Plans are billed monthly. Annual billing is not available.

entries.text: Both plans offer a 14-day trial. A credit card is not required to start the trial.
entries.quote: Both plans offer a 14-day trial. A credit card is not required to start the trial.

entries.text: Create a workspace, add a project, and share a review link with your client. Client reviewers do not need an account.
entries.quote: Create a workspace, add a project, and share a review link with your client. Client reviewers do not need an account.

entries.text: Will my clients count toward the team limit?
entries.quote: Will my clients count toward the team limit?

entries.text: Team members create and manage projects. Client reviewers only comment and approve work, and do not count toward the team-member limit.
entries.quote: Team members create and manage projects. Client reviewers only comment and approve work, and do not count toward the team-member limit.

entries.text: You can cancel from workspace settings. Access continues until the end of the current paid billing period.
entries.quote: You can cancel from workspace settings. Access continues until the end of the current paid billing period.

entries.text: What if I need more than five team members?
entries.quote: What if I need more than five team members?

entries.text: For more than five team members, ask the Clearbrief team about your requirements. This website does not publish pricing for larger teams.
